baseline_models.mechanism: Knowing crosses a graded boundary: the eye externalizes a nearly imperceptible breach, while the breast retains content before expression. The line pairs the thinnest outward trace with the deepest inward reserve.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to the knower supplies the capacity that spans both outward and inward registers.
Failure of entrusted fidelity makes the eye event a breach rather than neutral motion.
The bodily eye supplies the minimally visible channel through which the breach flickers outward.
Covering and secrecy supply the inward register that has not become public.
The bodily breast localizes the concealed interior against the exposed eye.

changed_reading.before: God knows a furtive glance and hidden thoughts.
changed_reading.after: The verse maps a continuum from a minimal visible breach to fully interior concealment; neither privacy threshold limits divine knowing.

baseline_models.mechanism: The gaze is treated as an entrusted faculty of attention and care. Its betrayal is a deficit of fidelity, even a quiet subtraction from what another is owed, before any overt bodily act occurs.

activation_trace.role: Breach of trust supplies the relational wrong carried by the glance.
Quiet diminishment sharpens betrayal as subtracting fidelity or another's due.
The eye as watchful care supplies the entrusted function that the treacherous gaze reverses.
Complete recognition makes the otherwise deniable deficit knowable.

changed_reading.before: The phrase denotes a sneaky or illicit look.
changed_reading.after: It denotes misuse of entrusted sight: a relational breach already present in how attention is directed, withheld, or appropriated.

baseline_models.mechanism: The breast can be read as an origin from which acts issue, and the eye as a distinguishing mark. Concealed intention therefore leaves an ocular trace, while divine knowing reaches the source without depending on uncertain human inference.

activation_trace.role: An origin from which actions issue turns the breast into the hidden source of outward conduct.
A distinguishing mark that guides to its object lets the eye function as a trace of the inward source.
Direct ocular manifestation supplies the observable endpoint of the source-to-trace relation.
Secrecy keeps the source inaccessible to ordinary observers even when a trace escapes.

changed_reading.before: The eye and breast are two independent objects of omniscience.
changed_reading.after: They can also form a source-and-trace mechanism: concealed interior orientation emits a tiny ocular sign whose origin is already fully known.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's present penetration of secrecy is set against a coming state of uncovered emergence. Concealment can persist socially for a time, but it never functions as epistemic cover and may not remain a public condition.

activation_trace.role: Present covering supplies the privacy condition whose durability is tested by the context.
Present knowing remains active before any public exposure occurs.
Emergence and uncovering provide the later exposed state toward which hidden interiors are oriented.
The explicit negation of hiddenness removes concealment as a final refuge.

structural_cues: 40:16 places universal emergence and the claim that nothing is hidden three ayat before the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies present concealment plus a nearby uncovered judgment scene; I infer known-now to exposed-later. Alternatively, 40:16 may describe universal bodily emergence without promising public disclosure of each secret.

changed_reading.before: God knows what remains permanently private.
changed_reading.after: Divine knowing already crosses privacy, while the surah gives that privacy an exposure horizon: hiddenness is temporary even when disclosure is delayed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The treacherous eye is not merely evidence of a later deed. As one of the body's acquiring faculties, its directed glance can itself enter the account and receive act-matched recompense.

activation_trace.role: The ocular movement is classified as a fidelity breach and therefore as morally chargeable conduct.
The eye supplies the bodily faculty performing the micro-action.
Matching an act with its recompense makes even small conduct consequential.
Acquiring limbs directly connect bodily faculties such as the eye to what a person earns.
Counting and accounting supply the register in which the micro-action is retained.

structural_cues: 40:17 assigns each soul recompense for what it acquired immediately before the heart, eye, and breast sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily acquisition, accounting, and an eye-breach; I infer that the glance can be an acquired deed in its own right. Alternatively, it may only expose a broader intention or act that bears the charge.

changed_reading.before: The glance is a tell that reveals hidden guilt.
changed_reading.after: The glance is also an accountable acquisition: moral action begins at the scale of directed attention before speech or larger motion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The interior is dynamic rather than a sealed store. Hearts rise toward throats while people hold back a filled outlet, so what breasts hide is pictured as compressed content approaching bodily manifestation without yet becoming speech.

activation_trace.role: Secrecy names the retained state of the inward content.
The breast supplies the bodily chamber from which the content is displaced.
The heart supplies the inward core moving under judgment pressure.
The throat supplies the boundary between retained interior and voiced exterior.
Closing an outlet after fullness models suppression under pressure rather than empty silence.

structural_cues: 40:18 locates hearts at throats and names the people as suppressing immediately before 40:19 names what breasts hide.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an inner organ, a throat boundary, and a blocked full outlet; I infer pressure toward expression. Alternatively, these may be bodily signs of eschatological terror without describing how ordinary secrets surface.

changed_reading.before: Breasts are static containers of inaccessible thoughts.
changed_reading.after: Breasts hold pressurized orientation that can migrate toward gaze, throat, or speech; divine knowledge precedes the moment it crosses the boundary.

context_deltas.mechanism: Knowing serves truthful adjudication rather than surveillance for its own sake. Hearing and seeing cover manifested evidence, insight reaches inward orientation, witnesses preserve marks, and failed excuses cannot overwrite the record.

activation_trace.role: Unhidden recognition supplies the complete evidentiary knowledge behind judgment.
Concealed material extends the evidentiary field beyond what ordinary witnesses perceive.
Decisive judgment gives the knowledge a juridical function.
Stable correspondence to reality identifies the standard governing the judgment.
Auditory perception adds spoken and sounded evidence to the adjudicative sensorium.
Ocular seeing directly covers the eye's manifested conduct.
Insight of the heart prevents seeing from being reduced to surface optics.
A witnessing mark makes a small sign durable enough to stand in the final evidentiary scene.
The failed excuse shows that retrospective speech cannot cancel the known inward and ocular record.

structural_cues: 40:20 follows the focus with judgment in truth and the paired attributes hearing and seeing.
40:51-52 later stage the rising of witnesses and the failure of wrongdoers' excuses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies knowing, true judgment, sensory attributes, witnesses, and failed excuses; I infer an evidence-to-verdict sequence. Alternatively, these attributes and scenes may be parallel assurances rather than a formal forensic chain.

changed_reading.before: The verse asserts exhaustive divine surveillance.
changed_reading.after: It asserts adjudicative competence: micro-gesture and hidden motive are known together so that judgment corresponds to reality rather than merely to public appearance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Concealment is morally ambivalent. A believer hides faith under lethal threat, so the focus need not classify everything hidden in breasts as treachery; its grammar explicitly assigns betrayal to the eyes and then adds whatever breasts conceal.

activation_trace.role: Breach of fidelity marks the eye-side object as culpable.
Secrecy by itself supplies no fixed moral valence for what the breasts retain.
Deliberate covering supplies a contextually faithful instance of concealment.
Secure inner trust identifies the concealed content as fidelity rather than betrayal.
Heart-settling assent locates protected faith precisely in the inward register.

structural_cues: 40:28 explicitly presents a believing man from Pharaoh's people concealing his faith while resisting a killing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies culpable eye-betrayal and protected concealed faith; I infer that the coordinated objects in 40:19 are not morally synonymous. Alternatively, 40:19 may pragmatically target guilty secrets even though its wording remains broader.

changed_reading.before: Both the eye's betrayal and the breast's concealment are hidden sins.
changed_reading.after: The verse knows across different moral valences: an eye can betray, while a breast can hide guilt, fear, need, or faithful commitment under threat.

context_deltas.mechanism: The breast is an origin of public conduct: inward self-enlargement that cannot reach its imagined goal issues as twisted disputation. Sealing the arrogant heart stabilizes the loop between concealed motive and repeated outward resistance.

activation_trace.role: The origin from which actions issue lets concealed breast-content function as a behavioral source.
Secrecy keeps the motive distinct from the public argument it generates.
Twisted contention supplies the outward behavior needing an inward driver.
The repeated breast-as-source image explicitly locates that driver inside the disputants.
Magnifying something in the breast specifies concealed self-enlargement as the driver.
Failure to reach the goal adds frustrated aspiration to the motive.
A stamped seal supplies persistence and closure in the inward mechanism.
The heart identifies the sealed core that sustains repeated resistance.

structural_cues: 40:56 explicitly places nothing but pride in the disputants' breasts and says they will not attain it.
40:35 pairs the same unauthorized disputation with a seal on every arrogant, domineering heart.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dispute, pride in breasts, non-attainment, and a sealed arrogant heart; I infer concealed pride to frustrated aspiration to public contention. Alternatively, these may be coexisting traits without a single causal loop.

changed_reading.before: What breasts hide means unspecified private thoughts.
changed_reading.after: The surah supplies a concrete causal specimen: concealed self-magnification can source public argument, while the visible argument only partially reveals its frustrated inward aim.

context_deltas.mechanism: The treachery of eyes can be a fracture between perception and acknowledgment. Heart-blindness and denial with knowledge allow a person to receive visible signs while the inward faculty refuses their recognized claim.

activation_trace.role: The bodily eye supplies actual perceptual access, preventing the model from becoming merely metaphorical.
Betrayal supplies the broken fidelity between received sight and inward acknowledgment.
Blindness of heart separates inward discernment from mere ocular capacity.
Insight of heart supplies the ethical counterpart to bodily seeing.
Denial despite knowledge gives the split a precise operation: recognition is present but withheld.

structural_cues: 40:58 contrasts the blind and the seeing alongside belief and action.
40:63 describes rejection of the signs, while the cited branch specifies denial occurring with knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily sight, heart-sight, and denial with knowledge; I infer a perception-to-acknowledgment breach. Alternatively, 40:58 may simply contrast moral populations rather than stages within one person's seeing.

changed_reading.before: A treacherous eye is one that looks where it should not.
changed_reading.after: It may also be an eye whose perception is internally disowned: vision arrives, but the breast withholds the fidelity of acknowledgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's present-tense divine knowing contrasts with delayed human knowing. Possessed knowledge can inflate confidence and support mockery, until coercive sight of overwhelming force produces recognition too late to function as faithful seeing.

activation_trace.role: Present disclosure to the knower supplies the stable epistemic pole.
Future recognition supplies delay on the human side of the contrast.
Knowledge held by the communities supplies a limited, self-contained epistemic possession.
Boastful delight turns possessed knowledge into affective insulation against correction.
Eye-and-insight seeing supplies the eventual forced recognition.
Overwhelming force supplies the coercive condition under which late sight finally aligns with admission.

structural_cues: 40:70 delays the rejecters' knowing, 40:83 depicts delight in their own knowledge, and 40:84 makes sight of force precede their declaration of belief.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies present divine knowing, future human knowing, self-satisfied knowledge, and force-induced sight; I infer a temporal and moral asymmetry. Alternatively, the scenes may concern different groups rather than one continuous psychology.

changed_reading.before: He knows more objects than human beings know.
changed_reading.after: His knowing also differs in timing and quality: it is prior and uncoerced, whereas human recognition may be delayed by cherished knowledge until sight becomes unavoidable.

context_deltas.mechanism: A breast can hold a practical need or intended destination that organizes movement. Hidden breast-content therefore includes projects and orientations, not only propositions or sins; the inward aim can direct the body's use of means before it is stated.

activation_trace.role: An origin from which acts issue lets the breast hold an action-guiding project.
Concealment keeps that project inward before movement or speech reveals it.
Benefit supplies the usable means surrounding the inward project.
Reaching a goal turns the chest's need into an itinerary rather than a static feeling.
Need and dependence specify the practical content carried in the breast.
The split-root image of aiming toward what is magnified adds directed intention to otherwise felt need.
The repeated source-image explicitly locates the journey-guiding aim in the breasts.

structural_cues: 40:80 locates a need in the breasts within a sequence of benefits, reaching, riding, and being carried.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies benefit, reaching, need, breasts, and transport; I infer inward need to chosen destination to movement. Alternatively, the phrase may simply denote a desired destination without implying concealment.

changed_reading.before: What breasts hide consists of private beliefs, emotions, or guilt.
changed_reading.after: It can include a tacit itinerary: needs and intended ends that quietly organize outward motion, whether morally charged or ordinary.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Reading the eye as a sentinel or intelligence channel is cross-domain and the split-root report image is form-distant. It remains anchored in the focus eye's spy branch, its betrayal, and the ruler's paired showing and seeing in 40:29. Downstream prose should present this only as an exploratory model of selectively managed visibility, not as the lexical translation of the focus phrase.

activation_trace.role: The eye as spy or sentinel supplies an intelligence channel capable of compromised reporting.
Breach of trust turns observation into selective or disloyal reporting.
A revealing mark prevents the compromised channel from fully controlling what its behavior discloses.
Showing or making visible supplies the ruler's control over what enters the public visual field.
Seeing supplies the private perceptual claim that the ruler makes the basis of public display.
The split-root image of transmitting a report sharpens managed sight into an authorized public account.

changed_reading.before: The focus concerns an individual's furtive glance.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it can model a compromised visual intelligence channel: seeing, showing, and reporting are selectively managed, yet the management itself leaves a known mark.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The move from hidden treachery or rancor to a physical collar is surprising because 40:71 uses the root on the surface for shackles. It remains anchored because that same packet root carries branches for concealed betrayal, chest-held rancor, and bodily fettering, directly touching the focus's betrayal and hidden breasts. Render it as a branch resonance in which inward fixation hardens outward, not as a claim that the surface noun means all three senses simultaneously.

activation_trace.role: Hidden breach of fidelity supplies the inward moral starting point.
The breast supplies the chamber in which the concealed fixation is held.
Concealed treachery echoes the focus breach within the shackle root's branch field.
Rancor lodged in the breast supplies the persistent inward fixation.
A collar fettering the limb supplies the outward hardened state of that fixation.
The neck localizes the external restraint at the same bodily threshold approached by the heart in 40:18.
Connected links make the restraint an extended material consequence rather than a momentary sign.
Dragging and extension supply the forced outward trajectory of what had been inwardly fixed.

changed_reading.before: Hidden betrayal remains an invisible moral fact known to God.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the surah's branch field lets concealed betrayal and chest-held rancor harden into the external restraint that carries a person along.

strongest_changes: The focus moved from a generic omniscience claim to a graded evidentiary mechanism joining micro-gesture, hidden motive, accounting, and truthful judgment.
40:28 prevents moralizing all concealment: hidden breast-content can be protected faith, while betrayal is assigned explicitly to the eyes.
40:18 and 40:56 make the breast dynamic: compressed content approaches expression, and concealed pride can source public disputation.
The late-surah sight and knowledge sequence contrasts present divine knowing with delayed, self-satisfied, or coerced human recognition.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah activation repeatedly converted the eye-breast pairing from two catalogued secrets into mechanisms: source and trace, pressure and outlet, deed and account, concealed fidelity versus betrayal, and inward aim directing outward conduct.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact grammatical range of خَآئِنَةَ may foreground a betraying act, quality, or instance; the retained models do not require deciding among them.
40:16 supports an exposure horizon but does not prove that every inward secret must become publicly disclosed rather than simply fully manifest to God.
The causal arrows from concealed pride to disputation and from hidden rancor to external restraint are abductive, not explicit syntax.
The protected faith of 40:28 establishes moral openness for concealed breast-content but does not by itself determine which contents 40:19 most immediately targets.
